ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/install` | POST | 安装 / 更新，body：`{ "repo": "owner/name", "answers": { "ENV_NAME": "值" } }`；返回 `done` / `awaiting-input` / `aborted` / `failed` / `manual` 状态 + 逐步日志 |

ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/uninstall` | POST | 卸载，body：`{ "repo": "owner/name" }`；删除安装目录 / 包目录 + `cordis.patch.yml` 注册条目 + 安装记录；返回 `done`（含 `removed` 计数与日志） |

ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/self-update` | POST | 执行市场本体更新（官方 CLI 安装 + 装后版本校验）；返回 `no-update` / `done` / `failed` |

ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/check-update` | POST | npm 型 cli 插件手动版本检测（body `{ repo }`；查 npm registry，npmmirror 优先）；返回 `done` + `updateAvailable` / `latestVersion` |

ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/feedback` | POST | 提交安装反馈（body `{ repo, ok, note }`）→ 移除队列并同步创建 GitHub issue；返回 `done`（含 `issueUrl` / `manualUrl`） |

ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/env-edit` | POST | 写入插件环境变量（body `{ repo, values }`，落盘 `~/.dsh/.env` + `envs.json`）；返回 `done` + `applied` |

ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/restore/diff` | POST | 给定备份计算恢复差异（body `{ backup }`；返回 `missing` / `already`） |

ioPairs.heading: ## 📡 HTTP 接口
ioPairs.excerpt: | `/api/marketplace/logs` | GET | 导出脱敏安装日志（`{ text, count }`） |

ioPairs.heading: ## Clicks that start real work
ioPairs.excerpt: | **Search** | Concurrent provider-native recall | Read-only |

ioPairs.heading: ## Clicks that start real work
ioPairs.excerpt: | **Agent query** | A clean top-level task Agent receives bounded evidence and writes an answer | Read-only |

ioPairs.heading: ## Clicks that start real work
ioPairs.excerpt: | **Remember** / **Save to memory** | A clean task Agent qualifies, routes, deduplicates, distills, and writes behind Host controls | Writes only if accepted |

ioPairs.heading: ## Clicks that start real work
ioPairs.excerpt: | **Smart selection** | Hard rules filter providers; a task Agent resolves only genuine ambiguity | Saves a routing receipt |

ioPairs.heading: ## Clicks that start real work
ioPairs.excerpt: | **AI metadata** | One asynchronous task Agent per selected Memory Space, each using the provider's fastest sample path | Local title/description only |

ioPairs.heading: ## Clicks that start real work
ioPairs.excerpt: | **Archive Document** | A task Agent creates a searchable cold reference before the Host moves the original | Supervised move |

ioPairs.heading: ## Clicks that start real work
ioPairs.excerpt: | **Turn memory** | Expands exact recall, write, and Document-search activity; each item navigates to its source | Read-only |
